selection: Once on all157 old selected paths: maximize map-mean strict success; tie map-mean nominal success; tie minimize map-mean RMS error over all paths; final tie smaller lookahead. No new-map outcomes available during selection.
pilot: Each of six old maps: earliest historical failure, then earliest success or latest failure if no success; ties job_id. Exactly12, fixed before new controller outcomes.
fixed_inputs: Original goal-facing yaw, zero pitch, v1m/s, dt0.1s, yaw10deg/s, pitch rate5deg/s, pitch20deg, goal0.75m, error3m, time min(600,max(60,3L/v+30)), original sphere/margin and mission ceiling. No current or model calibration.
curvature_reference: Standard horizontal circular fillets, R=v/yaw_max. Exact line/arc primitives, chord enclosure certification. Nonhorizontal or insufficient segment length explicitly unsupported/rejected. No claim of qualified general3D smoothing; only raw/shortcut enter formal3D matrix.
e0_history: Read all1099 5AR condition records once; augment every failure and list projection jumps>0.5m descriptively, not as automatic bugs. Replay fixed12 baselines against original track and old records.
local_tube: 1m reference arc-length neighborhood split at vertices; capped conservative physical/mission clearance and error/clearance ratio are warnings only. Continuous swept-sphere certification remains authoritative.
independent_maps: 12 new scenes from stage5ae_maps.json; new recipes, dimensions and endpoints; no reuse of old maps under new seeds. Generate/validate after development freeze; never select on outcomes.
gate: E0 correctness -> E1 analytic/pilot/full development -> E2 pairing and bounded horizontal reference -> commit selected parameters -> E3 36-trial resource gate -> full360 reusing all completed jobs. Stop on program errors, drift, accepted unsafe geometry or unresolved guard timeout; no dropping failure cases.
denominators: Geometry / known-feasible planning tasks; strict execution / eligible paths for each processing/controller; end-to-end / same known-feasible tasks. Envelope-unreachable, unknown and no-path kept separate.
uncertainty: Map as cluster. Fixed RNG 65888, 2000 map-bootstrap replicates; exploratory percentile95% intervals and paired differences. No seed-level independence or significance claims.
storage: Historical traces referenced in place; new compressed traces stored once outside repository; paths and controller conditions explicitly identified; no extra file hashes.
stop: Go-to-innovation / Refine-controller / Pivot-model / Inconclusive based on all evidence, then stop for researcher review. No new planning algorithm.
